note: Official BOM flood classification levels (metres) keyed by BOM station number, scraped from the 'Flood Classification Levels' line of each station's BOM river height plot page (source_url). datum='AHD' when BOM prints 'm AHD', otherwise 'LGH' (local gauge height, the same gauge datum as the bulletin reading). Levels are null where BOM publishes none. checked = date last fetched (AEST).
